p.strong: Who owns what, when it happens, and what unlocks the next stage.

div.p: USE LEFT → RIGHT, THEN MOVE DOWN. Complete both owner columns. Advance only after the stage gate passes.

g.text: EXCEPTION ROUTES — STOP THE MAIN FLOW; NEVER FORCE AN OPPORTUNITY FORWARD
SYSTEM CONTROLS — ACTIVE ACROSS ALL FOUR STAGES

div.p: A tracked, qualifying roofing customer with a signed agreement, confirmed payment pathway, cleared protected period, and no excluded duplicate.

g.text: BUYERPROOF FAIL → Exclude from pipeline → NO FEE
NOT READY → Return to nurture → NO FEE
LOST → Record exact reason → NO FEE
ROOFLOCK FAIL / REVERSAL → Reject or credit → NO EARNED FEE

text.tspan: No verified roof by day 45 + requirements met:
continue at no added performance cost OR
Use data to improve the next cycle
